There is no delete endpoint: use [updateShopEconomicOperator](/documentation/reference#operation/updateShopEconomicOperator) to correct a record. See the [GPSR Economic Operators Tutorial](/documentation/tutorials/gpsr-economic-operators) for the full guide, including eligibility and the enforcement timeline.
